Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

We are writing to update you on the schedule for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than expected, and as a result the delivery date has moved back by two weeks. We wanted to flag this as soon as the revised timeline was confirmed so you can plan accordingly.

The certification process is now complete, and our team is proceeding with the remaining integration and testing work on that basis. Based on the updated schedule, we are targeting 14 April as the new delivery date, and we do not anticipate any further changes at this stage. All other aspects of the project remain on track, and we will continue to keep you informed of progress in the coming weeks.

Would 14 April work on your end, or is there a scheduling constraint we should factor in? We are happy to set up a short call this week to walk through the revised plan in detail and answer any questions you may have. Thank you for your continued patience and partnership as we bring this project to completion.
